Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Website Content & Front-End Developer position at Manutan, as advertised. With a background blending digital marketing with hands-on web development, I am eager to contribute to shaping the future of B2B e-commerce.

My experience includes building and optimizing websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, managing content within various CMS platforms, and conducting thorough SEO analyses. I am proficient with tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console, enabling me to monitor performance and support data-driven decisions.

The opportunity to contribute to Manutan’s mission of continuous improvement and digital innovation resonates strongly with my professional goals. I am confident my technical skills and metrics-focused approach would be a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Manutan.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to enthusiastically apply for the Website Content & Front-End Developer position at Manutan, as recently posted. My professional journey, which combines a technical foundation in front-end development with robust digital marketing and SEO expertise, aligns directly with your mission to innovate in B2B e-commerce and enhance customer experience.

My background includes direct experience in building and optimizing functional and user-friendly websites. I have designed, built, and maintained multi-page sites and e-commerce stores using WordPress, Elementor, and Shopify, often incorporating hand-coded landing pages with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as demonstrated with baverok.com. My previous role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor further honed my skills in optimizing web application features. This practical experience ensures I can effectively assist in animating your core website and create key landing pages.

A core aspect of my work involves optimizing website performance and user experience. I have conducted iterative technical SEO audits and implemented structured data, measurably raising search-health scores for client sites like mirook.com. My proficiency extends to debugging pages, fixing broken links, and contributing to site optimisation for improved loading speeds. I am adept at using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to monitor traffic, conversions, and technical performance, skills directly applicable to your analytical requirements. My Google Analytics GA4 certification further underscores this capability.

I am particularly drawn to Manutan's emphasis on continuous improvement, data-driven decisions, and a collaborative culture. My profile highlights a metrics-focused approach and a deep interest in analyzing data to inform marketing decisions and contribute to Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies. I also pride myself on clear communication, able to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical personnel, which I believe would be valuable in documenting best practices and communicating global initiatives to local webmasters.

Thank you for considering my application. I am eager to contribute my blend of front-end development, content management, and analytical skills to Manutan's ambitious digital goals. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can help shape the future of your online presence.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- HTML/CSS/JavaScript Expertise: Directly applied front-end coding skills to build and optimize websites, including hand-coded landing pages and features for web applications.
- Website Building & Management: Comprehensive experience designing, building, and maintaining multi-page websites and e-commerce stores using WordPress, Elementor, and Shopify.
- SEO & Performance Optimization: Proven ability to conduct technical SEO audits, implement structured data, and optimize site performance for improved loading speeds and search visibility.
- Data Analysis & Reporting: Proficient in Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to monitor site performance, track results, and inform optimization strategies.
- Content Management & CRO Contribution: Managed website content, publishing and updating pages, and contributed to strategies aimed at growing organic traffic and improving conversions.
